# SUP Stocklot Direct

> Inflatable SUP overstock, cancelled-order stocklots and wholesale supply for verified B2B buyers. FOB Qingdao (CNQDG), 72-hour pressure QC, third-party inspection welcome. B2B only — minimum 50 pcs / 1 pallet.

Bilingual note: the site is English-only. The seller serves importers, distributors, rental operators, schools and clubs worldwide; regular lanes are US, EU, UK, Canada, Australia and New Zealand.

## Key pages

- [Home — tiered manifest unlock](https://supstocklot.com/): featured lots, buyer solutions, 5-field business verification form (Tier 1 instant / Tier 2 assisted / Tier 3 filtered)
- [Available SUP stock](https://supstocklot.com/available-sup-stock/): full catalog with type/grade/status filters
- [Wholesale inflatable SUP](https://supstocklot.com/wholesale-inflatable-sup/): dealer-tier bulk pricing, mixed lots, full-lot take-all deals
- [SUP overstock & clearance](https://supstocklot.com/sup-overstock/): liquidation lots, cosmetic seconds, AS-IS honesty
- [SUP boards for rental](https://supstocklot.com/sup-boards-for-rental/): fleet purchasing for rental businesses and resorts
- [SUP boards for schools](https://supstocklot.com/sup-boards-for-schools/): class sets and club equipment
- [Small-batch SUP orders](https://supstocklot.com/small-batch-sup-orders/): trial orders from 10 boards / 1 pallet, express and LCL
- [Shipping & import](https://supstocklot.com/shipping/): express/LCL/FCL lanes, HS code 9506.99.00, US/EU-GPSR/UK/CA/AU compliance notes
- [How to buy](https://supstocklot.com/how-to-buy/): the 5-step RFQ-to-container process
- [About](https://supstocklot.com/about/): honest liquidation positioning
- [Contact & RFQ](https://supstocklot.com/contact/): full RFQ form (business email, WhatsApp, company, business nature, take-off volume)
- [Terms](https://supstocklot.com/terms/): AS-IS, no brand warranty, deposit and inspection finality
- [Lot details](https://supstocklot.com/available-sup-stock/): each lot has a detail page at /stock/{slug}/ with tier pricing, carton data, a container loading calculator and Product JSON-LD

## Facts

- Port of loading: Qingdao, China (CNQDG). Incoterms: FOB Qingdao / EXW Qingdao warehouse (Incoterms 2020).
- QC: every board inflated to 15–18 PSI for 72 continuous hours, max pressure drop 0.05 bar (protocol WI-QC-AT-001 Rev A).
- Payment: 30–50% non-refundable T/T deposit locks the allocation (15-day hold); balance before dispatch or against B/L copy. No open account, no usance L/C.
- Dispatch: 3–5 business days after payment confirmation.
- HS code: 9506.99.00 (watersports equipment).
- Sample lots on the site are clearly marked SAMPLE DATA and are replaced with live inventory before launch.

## Inventory portal

Verified buyers receive portal credentials from the sales desk (WhatsApp +86 133 0532 4192). The portal (not indexed, excluded from the sitemap) carries branded photos, packing lists, barcode ranges, the full gated manifest, a multi-lot stowage simulator, an RFQ panel and the binding Terms of Sale. Do not request portal access for single-board consumer purchases — the site is B2B only.
